## Shipped Products & Architectural Specifications

### 1. WriteFrankly {#writefrankly}
- **Live URL**: [https://writefrankly.ai.studio/](https://writefrankly.ai.studio/)
- **Category**: Private Reflection & Journaling Companion
- **Stack**: Gemini API, Cloud Run, Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase, Web Crypto AES-GCM
- **Architecture**:
  - Engineered dynamic multi-turn Gemini API dialogue trees with real-time prompt calibration.
  - Implemented client-side Web Crypto AES-GCM 256-bit encryption with in-RAM PII masking prior to model context serialization, achieving zero plaintext storage of private journal entries.
  - Deployed to Google Cloud Run serverless containers with zero cold-start state loss.

### 2. MakanSini 2.0 {#makansini}
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/4ranklyn/MakanSiniv2](https://github.com/4ranklyn/MakanSiniv2)
- **Category**: Culinary Intelligence & Geospatial Recommendation MVP
- **Stack**: Gemini API, Google Places API, Cloud Run, Go, React, Docker
- **Architecture**:
  - Shipped cross-platform MVP in 7 days to eliminate student food decision fatigue.
  - Integrated Gemini models with Google Places API for real-time spatial intent mapping, prompt-injection sanitization filters, and sub-400ms p95 latency on Cloud Run.

### 3. VeraGate {#veragate}
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/4ranklyn/veragate](https://github.com/4ranklyn/veragate)
- **Category**: Autonomous Multimodal Forensic Audit Engine
- **Stack**: Gemini 3, Multi-Agent Systems, Next.js, TypeScript, Docker, Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- **Architecture**:
  - Dual-agent architecture featuring a **Watcher** (multimodal frame-by-frame video extractor) and an **Auditor** (technical PDF schema analyzer).
  - Evaluates spatial, temporal, and specification contradictions between video inspections and regulatory documentation, streaming structured reasoning logs via SSE.

### 4. CeKulit {#cekulit}
- **Repository**: [https://github.com/4ranklyn/cekulit-ml](https://github.com/4ranklyn/cekulit-ml)
- **Category**: AI Dermatological Diagnostic Mobile App
- **Stack**: TensorFlow, Cloud Flask API, Google Cloud, Mobile (Android), Python
- **Architecture**:
  - Optimized lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures attaining 84%+ diagnostic accuracy.
  - Deployed Cloud Flask inference API maintaining sub-$1/day operational COGS.
